audit.probe: L2 logistic regression, one-vs-rest for >2 classes
audit.C_selection: inner 1/5 split of the probe-training data, mean one-vs-rest AUC
audit.fold_aggregation: AUC per test fold, then mean
audit.pairs: matched pairs kept in one fold
audit.constant_coordinates: probe-training SD < 1e-06 x median SD: treated as constant (dropped from that fold's probes)

config.pool: latents with training firing rate in [0.02, 0.98]: the set MI scores
config.ranking: top N of one ranking per selector (nested); ties to the lower latent id; mi: the published rule, argsort(scores)[::-1]
config.dip: diptest.dipstat on X_tr d_j, every training document
config.random: 5 draws per SAE; draw j of seed s, fold f: uniform permutation of the pool from default_rng([1000, s, j, 1, f]), prefixes (focused_additions.latent_draw)
config.gauss: 1 draws; unit-norm N(0, I) rows from default_rng([1000, s, j, 0])
